legal.summary: CRITICAL RISK: The seller fails all legal trust checks. Romanian consumer law strictly prohibits waiving the 14-day right of withdrawal from distance contracts (any such waiver clause is legally null and void). Missing company registration and absence of ANPC/SOL links indicate a likely fraudulent shop.
